title: New Jersey utility assistance
facts: New Jersey lists LIHEAP and Universal Service Fund assistance for energy bills.
applicability: Energy bills; not every type of utility bill is covered.

title: New Jersey Charity Care
facts: New Jersey Charity Care offers free or reduced-charge eligible acute-care hospital services subject to income, asset and other requirements.
Apply through the hospital where services were provided; separate physician and other charges may not be covered.
applicability: Confirm the hospital and service location; residence alone does not establish coverage.

title: IRS hospital financial assistance policies
facts: Tax-exempt hospital organizations must maintain a written financial assistance policy.
applicability: Tax-exempt hospitals; verify the actual provider and its policy.

title: Federal LIHEAP assistance finder
facts: The federal LIHEAP Clearinghouse provides a tool to find local energy assistance offices.
applicability: Energy assistance navigation only; confirm current enrollment and local requirements.
